title: Implement a deterministic token-bucket rate limiter
prompt: You are working in the current directory. There is a file `rate_limiter.py` containing a class `TokenBucket` whose `__init__` and `allow` methods raise `NotImplementedError`. Implement both methods exactly according to the docstrings already written in the file. The class must never read a real clock (no `time.time()` or similar); the current time is always supplied by the caller as the `now` argument to `allow`. Do not change the class name, method names, or signatures. Run `python -m pytest tests_visible -q` to check your work; note that the visible tests only cover a subset of behavior described in the docstrings, so re-read the docstrings carefully and handle every case they describe, including the `n_tokens` default, the `ValueError` case, and out-of-order `now` values.
